original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 Extended BIOS Size encoding and resulting capacity match the approved platform firmware size and remain stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 0 and its standard/extended ROM-size encoding, confirm whether the extended field is applicable, retain raw unit/selector semantics, normalize to bytes, compare with the platform expectation, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves applicability, expected capacity and plan. Encoding analysis, normalized comparison and reboot are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected extended BIOS capacity and semantics
SMBIOS version plus standard/extended field selection rule
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; no flash probe/write is authorized.
Preserve raw Type 0/errors and selector/unit semantics before normalization.
Do not duplicate the earlier ROM Size result unless the platform proves the extended field supplied it.
Stop on inapplicable/ambiguous encoding, overflow, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 0/tool/SMBIOS identity, determine standard versus extended size applicability, normalize the extended result and compare before/after reboot.
Do not invent encoding semantics, access flash destructively or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve applicability, expected capacity/region and unit-selector rules.
Resolve encoding differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fragile: installed dmidecode may render the selected result simply as `ROM Size` rather than a literal Extended Bios Size label; stderr suppression and insecure transport are unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 and version/errors, verify which encoded field supplies the displayed size and retain raw/normalized evidence before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, extended-size scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record SMBIOS version, legacy size selector, extended-size magnitude/unit and normalized byte count so the extended field is proven rather than inferred from a display label.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 implementations using Extended BIOS ROM Size.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Type 0 size encoding baseline and approved tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds applicability/selector proof and raw encoding preservation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; distinguishes extended encoding from generic ROM Size display.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected capacity, selector and unit semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Human-readable tools may collapse standard/extended fields into one ROM Size line, requiring version-verified evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may mark the extended field inapplicable only with its SMBIOS/size encoding evidence; it cannot reuse the standard ROM Size result without attribution.
expected_evidence: Approval, extended applicability/expected capacity, platform and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 encoding plus normalized capacity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently target the extended size; its applicability/value are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field semantics are known. Missing platform/tool mapping affects readiness but is not permanent blockage.

review_improvement: Prevents duplicate evidence from the adjacent ROM Size case and validates the actual extended encoding path.
